name: lamad
description: Learning and mastery platform — knowledge discovery, assessment, paths, and stewardship

concept.description: A fundamental idea or principle in the knowledge graph. Concepts are the atomic units of understanding that learners build mastery over.

lesson.description: A structured teaching unit that guides learners through a topic with explanations, examples, and practice opportunities.

assessment.description: A graded evaluation of learner understanding. Produces mastery attestations and drives the mastery level progression.

exercise.description: A practice activity that reinforces understanding. Unlike assessments, exercises are ungraded and focus on skill building.

experience-story.description: A durable narrative junction representing (subject, role, feature) — the persona's experience with a feature in a given role. Accumulates value via :story-point attestations over time.

experience-moment.description: One persona's first-person recording of one scenario at one moment. Agent-scoped (private source-chain entry). Projected locally per persona; never gossipped.

reflection.description: An open-ended prompt for self-reflection and metacognition. Not graded — produces qualitative insight rather than scores.

discussion.description: A collaborative dialogue space tied to content. Enables peer learning and community sensemaking around topics.

article.description: Long-form written content — essays, explainers, deep dives. The primary narrative format for knowledge sharing.

path.description: A curated learning journey — an ordered sequence of steps through content. Paths are EPR composites that reference other content types.

epic.description: A high-level narrative arc that organizes features and scenarios into a coherent story. Epics frame the why behind learning content.

scenario.description: A BDD scenario specifying observable behavior — Given/When/Then. Scenarios are executable specifications that validate learning outcomes.

discovery-assessment.description: Self-discovery quiz (Enneagram, learning style, values inventory). Ungraded — produces psychometric insights rather than scores.

instrument.description: A psychometric instrument definition — subscales, scoring rules, and display configuration for discovery assessments.

quiz.description: A lightweight graded question set — simpler than a full assessment, typically embedded within lessons or used for quick knowledge checks.

course-module.description: A thematic grouping of lessons, exercises, and assessments within a path. Provides intermediate structure between path and individual content.

module.description: A generic content module — a reusable, self-contained unit that can be composed into different paths and course structures.

community.description: A community group or collective in the learning network. App-layer rendering hint for community identity and membership.

tool.description: An external tool or utility referenced in the learning context. Provides metadata and links for tools learners need during their journey.

placeholder.description: A placeholder for missing or errored content. Shown when content cannot be loaded — ensures the graph remains navigable.

simulation.description: An interactive HTML5 simulation or game that teaches through experiential learning. Served via iframe from doorway.

feature.description: A BDD feature file grouping related scenarios. Maps to Gherkin Feature blocks and organizes executable specifications.

practice.description: A structured practice activity with specific skill-building objectives. More guided than an exercise, with defined success criteria.

gate-process-declaration.description: An app-manifest-declared gate-process DAG. Carries the step graph an elohim executes when a RelationalImpactEvent fires for a given content type. CID-addressed and inspectable (spec P3). See elohim/elohim-agent/spec/2026-04-18-gate-interface.md §2.

universal-band-declaration.description: Protocol-root universal-band DAG — the wisdom-as-system-auth layer that wraps every relational-impact invocation. Structurally identical to gate-process-declaration but protocol-reach governed. Referenced by a well-known constitutional pointer.

gate-rules-declaration.description: Parameter artifact for the `mechanical-ruleset` step type. An ordered rule list referenced by CID from a gate-process-declaration. Example: the 7-valence discernment ruleset for experience-moment.

aggregation-spec.description: Parameter artifact for the `aggregate-attestations` step type. Declares how a step queries the DHT attestation graph and reduces results to a scalar (e.g., reach-level tiers for reach-gate).

escalation-target-spec.description: Parameter artifact for the `escalate-to-review` step type. Declares where escalated decisions route (app-steward / qahal / existential-boundary) and at what severity tier.

markdown.description: Markdown documents with optional YAML frontmatter. The primary narrative format for written content.

gherkin.description: Behavior-Driven Development feature files with Given/When/Then syntax. Executable specifications.

sophia-quiz-json.description: Sophia psychometric assessment format for mastery quizzes, discovery assessments, and reflection prompts.

html5-app.description: Interactive HTML5 applications served from doorway. Content is extracted from zip archives and cached for iframe embedding.

spa-bundle.description: Single-page application served as a doorway's root web surface. ZIP archive extracted and cached by doorway with SPA routing (unmatched paths serve index.html).

epr-composite.description: EPR composite layout — a content node whose body references other EPRs. Used for paths, curated collections, and landing pages.

html.description: HTML content rendered directly. Falls back to the markdown renderer for consistent styling.

plaintext.description: Plain text content with no formatting. Rendered through the markdown renderer for consistent layout.

video-embed.description: Embedded video content from external providers (YouTube, Vimeo). Rendered in an iframe with appropriate sizing.

json.description: Raw JSON data format. Used for structured content that doesn't fit other format categories.

CONTAINS.description: Parent-child hierarchical containment. The source contains the target as a sub-element.

BELONGS_TO.description: Reverse of CONTAINS — the source is a child of the target.

DESCRIBES.description: High-level narrative describes a lower-level implementation. The source provides context or explanation for the target.

IMPLEMENTS.description: Implementation realizes a narrative. The source concretely implements what the target describes.

VALIDATES.description: The source tests or verifies understanding of the target. Assessments validate concepts, scenarios validate features.

RELATES_TO.description: Generic bidirectional association between content. Used when a more specific relationship type does not apply.

REFERENCES.description: The source cites or references the target. A weaker form of RELATES_TO indicating directional citation.

DEPENDS_ON.description: The source depends on the target for correctness or completeness. Implies the target should exist for the source to be meaningful.

REQUIRES.description: The source has a prerequisite relationship with the target. Learners must complete the target before the source.

FOLLOWS.description: Sequential ordering — the source comes after the target in a learning sequence. Suggests but does not require completion order.

ATTACHED_TO.description: Attachment link — the source is attached supplementary material for the target (e.g., a story with attached media).

learning-signal.description: Emitted when a learner engages with content — views, reads, or interacts. The foundational attention signal for the learning economy.

mastery-achieved.description: Emitted when a learner levels up in mastery for a concept. Produces a mastery attestation that flows value to content stewards.

assessment-completed.description: Emitted when a learner completes an assessment or quiz. Triggers evaluation resource accounting and recognition flows.

path-completed.description: Emitted when a learner completes all steps in a learning path. A major milestone that produces path-completion attestation.

practice-engagement.description: Emitted when a learner actively practices with exercises, simulations, or interactive content. Distinct from passive viewing.

contribution-created.description: Emitted when a steward creates, curates, or reviews content. Produces a contribution record that builds stewardship standing.

experience-attestation.description: A :story-point attestation minted by the discernment gate when meaningful evidence is recognized. Emitted alongside the Holochain Link; dual-encoded as an EconomicEvent in shefa.

peer-review-completed.description: Emitted when a peer review of content is completed. Produces a peer attestation that strengthens content trust and steward standing.

knowledge-retention.description: Learner can recall and apply concept after interval

retention-failure.description: Learner cannot recall or apply concept after interval

mastery-attestation-meaningful.description: Mastery-attested learners succeed in downstream prerequisites

downstream-prerequisite-failure.description: Mastery-attested learners fail in downstream content they should be prepared for

stewardship-distributed.description: Content domain has diverse steward participation

stewardship-concentrated.description: Single steward controls disproportionate share of domain content

content-relevant.description: Content is current and referenced by active learning paths

content-outdated.description: Content no longer reflects current understanding (human-reported or instrument-detected)

content-misleading.description: Content framing does not match substance (human-reported)

learning-outcome-achieved.description: Learner demonstrates competence in the domain a path covers after completion

path-completion-without-retention.description: Learner completed path but cannot demonstrate competence in its domain

community-value-confirmed.description: Community contributions produce engagement and downstream learning

engagement-decline.description: Community contributions are not producing engagement or downstream learning

peer-review-verified.description: A gate-process-declaration or universal-band-declaration has been reviewed by qualified peers and accepted as sound constitutional logic

manifest-challenged.description: A gate-process-declaration has been formally challenged (incorrectness, scope-creep, or jurisdiction overreach)

discernment-gate-v1-mechanical.description: Seven-valence discernment of experience-moments; mints :story-point attestations.

reach-gate-v1.description: Attestation-graph-aggregated reach level for content-node subjects.

content-safety-gate-v1.description: Wide protocol gate evaluating content body / payload safety for ContentPublish, AttestationWrite, and PeerMessage events. Emits Allow or Decline{category:content-safety}. Runs before specialised domain gates.
